# Cloud-deck height sensitivity (auto-generated by `build/cloud_sensitivity.py`)

The all-sky estimate uses one grey cloud deck (cover 0.67).  For each deck height the opacity is re-tuned so the model longwave cloud effect equals 27.9 W m-2 (CERES EBAF Ed4.0).  Entries: all-sky radiative efficiency / AR6 value, and the all-sky top-of-atmosphere forcing of doubled CO2 (clear sky: 2.76 W m-2).

| deck layer (km) | tau_c | CFC-11 | CFC-12 | HCFC-22 | HFC-134a | HFC-23 | SF6 | CF4 | CCl4 | mean | CO2 2x all-sky |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1-2 | cannot match (even a black deck is too weak) | | | | | | | | | | |
| 2-3 | cannot match (even a black deck is too weak) | | | | | | | | | | |
| 5-6 | 0.68 | 1.08 | 1.02 | 1.14 | 1.19 | 1.17 | 1.11 | 1.31 | 1.25 | 1.16 | 2.01 |
| 6-8 | 0.43 | 1.11 | 1.05 | 1.18 | 1.23 | 1.22 | 1.15 | 1.32 | 1.26 | 1.19 | 2.02 |
| 8-10 | 0.29 | 1.16 | 1.11 | 1.24 | 1.30 | 1.29 | 1.21 | 1.36 | 1.30 | 1.25 | 2.05 |

A low deck cannot reach the observed cloud effect (low clouds are too warm), which is why the default is mid-troposphere.  The spread across heights that can match the observation indicates the structural uncertainty of the all-sky estimate.
